item.title: Former U.S. Treasury official buys Ocala golf club for $63 million, plans luxury community
item.description: A sprawling Ocala golf course and country club originally developed by billionaire Frank Stronach has been sold for $63 million to an investment group led by a former high-ranking U.S. Treasury official who most recently held an executive position at Freddie Mac. item.title: I have lived in Ocala for 20 years and I am leaving
item.description: "I've lived here for 20 years. And I am moving out. It's gotten so bad here. Traffic, crime, nasty people, shooting, people being run over (and they don't stop). You used to be able to walk downtown. If you can find a place to park, now you have to pay. We no longer go there. And we never travel on State Road 200. Way too much traffic and way too close. Everything is a U-turn and 3-minute stoplights. No wonder people run red lights. We're over it, you ruined the city." - An Ocala resident shares
